title: 헌법연구관 등의 근무성적평정 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Persons Subject to Appraisal)
(1) Performance appraisals shall be conducted for Constitution Research Officers and Assistant Constitution Research Officers (including such officers seconded from other state agencies; hereinafter referred to as "persons subject to appraisal"); provided, Constitution Research Officers who receive remuneration equivalent to that of a Vice-Minister or higher and are designated by the President of the Constitutional Court shall be excluded.
(2) Where the period of service during the relevant appraisal period is less than two months due to leave of absence, long-term overseas training, or any other reason, no appraisal shall be conducted.
